_data: Same run, from raw pinned text instead of the pre-tokenized stream -- the published v11 tokenizer runs on the worker. Slower, and the token order depends on this config's seed rather than being fixed by the artifact, so it is NOT bit-reproducible the way real.json is. Kept because it is the arm that proves the pre-tokenized stream and the tokenizer agree: same corpus, same tokenizer, two routes.
